articles.title: Big outcomes during PM Modi's Indonesia visit; India to support development of Indonesian EVMS, export Astra missiles
articles.summary: PM Modi's Indonesia state visit is expected to yield significant bilateral outcomes including India's support for Indonesian EVM development, export of Astra missiles, investment in critical minerals manufacturing, and joint development of Sabang port.

articles.title: PM Narendra Modi receives grand ceremonial welcome in Jakarta
articles.summary: PM Modi received a grand ceremonial welcome in Jakarta upon arriving for his official state visit to Indonesia, marking the commencement of his three-nation diplomatic tour to strengthen bilateral strategic cooperation.

articles.title: "Australia-India relationship of great importance": Diaspora voices enthusiasm ahead of PM Modi's Australia visit
articles.summary: Indian diaspora members in Australia expressed enthusiasm ahead of PM Modi's scheduled visit to Australia from July 8-10, highlighting the growing strategic partnership between the two countries.

articles.title: PM Modi departs for 3-nation visit to Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand
articles.summary: PM Modi departed on July 6 for a three-nation diplomatic visit to Indonesia, Australia, and New Zealand aimed at strengthening India's Act East Policy and MAHASAGAR Vision for enhanced strategic cooperation.

articles.title: Trump reshares PM Modi's wishes on 250th anniversary of US independence
articles.summary: US President Trump reshared PM Modi's post extending congratulations to the United States on its 250th independence anniversary, highlighting India-US strategic partnership and shared democratic values.
